name: AlignmentPicker
summary: Where a box's contents sit, chosen on a 3 by 3 grid of points, as in a design tool's auto layout. Each point is one choice; the chosen one carries the accent mark, the others a quiet dot. The grid is one enclosure; its points stay bare at rest. Not for choosing among named options (use SegmentedControl or Select) or for a text's alignment (a SegmentedControl of text-alignment icons).
a11y: A `radiogroup` named by `label`; each point is a `radio` named by its place ("Top left"), checked when chosen. One tab stop: the chosen point. Arrow keys move in two dimensions and choose as they move, as a radio group does. Points are 24 px targets on a dense surface, by decision. Forced colours keep the chosen mark in Highlight.

keys.action: move to the neighbouring point and choose it
the first or last point in the row

props.name: names
props.description: The nine points' names, row by row from the top start: "Top left" … "Bottom right". Defaults to English names for a left-to-right canvas; pass the product's own words (from content) for anything else.
